acceptance_criteria: All 15 pinned gate names and defaults, explicit false for stable gates per executable source
First duplicate value wins; plus/percent decoding, strict query errors, exact ParseBool byte spellings
Failed replacement preserves active map; successful replacement resets unspecified gates to defaults
Deterministic sorted Go-compatible query encoding and EnableAllFeatures
Runtime-independent CGP policy and configured existing Rusternetes controller contexts with SDK propagation

Default production constructors initialize source defaults through CGP; disabled-feature source fixtures explicitly request SidecarContainers=false or ScheduledAutoscaler=false instead of changing their assertions.
Raw query bytes preserve Go string semantics, including invalid UTF-8 in an ignored duplicate; typed errors retain raw invalid key/value bytes.
The same production parser provider compiles and runs unchanged in a minimal downstream CGP context with independent source assertions.
assurance: Ordinary implementation and real Rusternetes MemoryStorage/provider integration only; no source-property extraction or formal proof credited.
reachable_call_paths: CreatingGameServerController::new, FleetAutoscalerController::new, FleetAutoscalerAdmissionContext::default and SdkSidecarConfig::new -> CGP feature parser provider -> initialized source defaults; existing production controller/provider call sites use these constructors.
Configured CreatingGameServerController -> feature parser provider -> PodBuildFeatures -> existing CGP GameServer stack / Pod construction
Configured CreatingGameServerController -> sdk sidecar builder -> FEATURE_GATES environment
Configured FleetAutoscalerController -> parse provider -> scheduled/wasm CGP policy dispatch and webhook request metadata
reopened_reason: Extend the canonical CGP query domain to raw Go string bytes, retaining first-duplicate semantics even for an ignored non-UTF-8 value.
residual_work: Process CLI/environment input precedence is a separate configuration-input surface; Viper binding source subcase remains open.
Transport-specific textual formatting of arbitrary invalid Unicode errors remains to be matched at the application error boundary; typed errors preserve original decoded bytes.
Additional feature effects, top-level process lifecycle and every remaining source feature remain open.
